nx_tip_0: Hold left or right to glide along the shelf.
nx_tip_1: L and R jump five games at a time.
nx_tip_2: Minus turns the case around and shows how long you've played.
nx_tip_3: Y sets up a duel between two random games.
nx_tip_4: The gold case is the game you left paused.
nx_tip_6: X on a game: move it to a category or make a new one.
nx_tip_7: Spin the right stick in circles and watch the shelf.
nx_tip_8: A game opened 100 times earns a collector's rim.
nx_tip_9: After a minute of stillness, the shelf takes a stroll.
nx_tip_10: On the lock screen, the list holds brightness, volume and your headphones.
nx_tip_11: HOME inside a game shows how long you've been playing.
